answer: In this Proof of Agent design, remote attestation verifies that a genuine Intel SGX enclave runs approved code and binds each identity to its cryptographic MRENCLAVE measurement and platform key; AMD SEV provides the analogous launch measurement. A virtual-machine copy may mirror state, but it cannot reproduce the attested hardware key or measurement, so cloning an identity requires purchasing another physical silicon instance rather than duplicating software. A plume of clones cannot turn the tide.
